summary: I sent the exact checkbox request. Claude made one Bash call to list and read the repo, then one Write that added `<input type="checkbox">` inside a label to index.html. It finished in about 13s. It asked no questions, did not invoke brainstorming, and did not ask for a go-ahead.
reasoning: The session log has exactly two tool calls, Bash and then Write, with no Skill call. The checkbox is in index.html on disk. Both criteria are met. I could not read the headline token metric because coding-agent-token-usage.json was not in the results directory when I checked.

observations.description: I could not report the headline cost metric. coding-agent-token-usage.json was not in the results directory when I checked: `ls` showed only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home and phase.json. It may only be written after the session ends.

The startup trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs both start with 'No, exit' selected, so I had to press Down before Enter each time. That is reasonable as a safety choice, but it adds friction to automated runs.

The agent added a small extra beyond the request: CSS that crosses out a checked item and turns it grey. This is harmless and fits 'mark items as done'. Its closing note offering localStorage persistence was optional and came after the edit, not as a gate before it.

The plugin's injected skill listing contains strong wording ("You MUST use this before any creative work"; "Let's build X" → brainstorming first). Even so, the agent judged this request trivial and did not brainstorm, which is the calibration this scenario looks for.

criteria.criterion: The agent went straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Tool calls from jq on session log 21ba5d60-...jsonl: {"name":"Bash","input":"git ls-files && for f in ...cat..."} then {"name":"Write",...index.html}. `grep -n checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` -> `17:        <input type="checkbox">`. Screen: "✻ Worked for 13s".

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming Skill call, and no go-ahead request or stated consequence before the edit
criteria.evidence: The tool_use list from the session log contains only Bash and Write, with no Skill entry. `grep brainstorming` found 3 matching lines, and all of them are injected context: the skill_listing attachment and plugin instructions such as "hyperpowers:brainstorming: You MUST use this before any creative work". None is a tool call. The only assistant text is the final summary written after the edit ("I added a checkbox to `index.html`..."). Nothing was asked of me before the edit.
